briefTitle: Study to Evaluate Sutetinib Maleate Capsule in Locally Advanced or Metastatic Non-small Cell Lung Cancer

typedChecks.sourceText: Age 18 years old and above, male or female.
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Age 18 years old and above, male or female.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC is in scope, but there is no specific stage list for a stage_in check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: At least one measurable lesion.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: A minimum life expectancy of > 3 months.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Life expectancy is a subjective clinical judgment, not a typed lab or stage check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Adequate bone marrow reserve, hepatic, renal and coagulation function.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: General organ function without specific numeric cutoffs is fuzzy.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Any systemic anti-tumor therapy such as chemotherapy, and radiation therapy (including curative radiotherapy or spinal radiotherapy portion >30%) used within 3 weeks prior to enrollment; immunotherapy within 4 weeks; any palliative radiotherapy for non-target lesions used to relieve symptoms and traditional Chinese medicines indicated for the tumor (including Chinese patent medicine) within 2 weeks prior to enrollment.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex multi-category washout windows with varying timelines cannot be expressed as a simple typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Use or intake of drugs or foods containing potent inhibitor or inducer of cytochrome P450 isozyme 3A4 (CYP3A4) within 14 days or 5 half-lives, whichever was the longer, prior to enrollment.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Concomitant medication restriction for CYP3A4 inhibitors/inducers is not a typed prior therapy check.
